description: Businesses processing secondary raw materials, by region is a series of data sets listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Finance of Kyrgyzstan. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. The portal lists 4 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its title on the portal is "Список субъектов предпринимательства, занимающихся переработкой вторичного сырья - г. Бишкек" (Russian). The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Finance of Kyrgyzstan. Its tags are Экономика. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2020-01-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
